meta.description: Mock industrial + retail video surveillance dataset covering factory safety, security, production, logistics, compliance, and retail analytics scenarios. Each video has snapshots at 10-second intervals with VLLM-generated captions and a summary field.

videos.title: Production Line A - Morning Shift
videos.summary: Morning shift on Production Line A with 4 workers at stations. Station 3 remains unattended for 30 seconds causing a gap in output. Conveyor runs continuously with periodic operator intervention. All stations fully staffed by the end of the shift handoff.

snapshots.caption: Four workers positioned at their stations on Production Line A. Station 1 and 2 are active with workers handling components. Station 3 is empty. The conveyor belt moves steadily with evenly spaced components.

Worker at Station 1 inspects a component and places it back on the conveyor. Station 3 remains empty and unattended. At Station 4, a worker adjusts a machine calibration setting using a control panel.

Station 3 still unattended. A red indicator light flashes at the empty station. Other workers remain focused on their tasks. The conveyor belt shows a visible gap where Station 3's processed components should be.
Worker from Station 2 glances toward empty Station 3 and gestures briefly, but continues working. The conveyor gap widens as unprocessed components accumulate further down the line.
A worker arrives at Station 3 and begins setting up the workstation. The red flashing light stops. Other stations continue normal operation. The backlog on the conveyor is visible.
Station 3 worker processes components at an accelerated pace to clear the backlog. Production flow begins to normalize. Station 2 worker returns focus to their own station.
Full production line operating normally. All four stations staffed and active. Conveyor belt moving at standard speed with even component spacing restored.

videos.title: PPE Compliance Check
videos.summary: Workers near the production area show varying PPE compliance. One worker enters without a helmet, another enters the machine zone without a safety jacket. A safety officer notices but does not intervene until the end. Full PPE worn by only one worker.

snapshots.caption: Two workers walk past the PPE check station near the production area entrance. Worker A wears full PPE including helmet, safety jacket, and goggles. Worker B does not wear a helmet and has no goggles.
Worker B enters the production area without a helmet. A safety officer standing near the entrance notices the violation but does not call out or intervene immediately.
Worker C approaches the machine zone entrance. The worker wears a helmet but no safety jacket. Warning signs about mandatory PPE are posted on the wall next to the entrance.
Worker C enters the machine zone without a safety jacket. Other workers inside the zone are wearing full PPE including jackets. Worker C walks past an active milling machine.
Worker B is now deep inside the production area still without a helmet. Worker A continues working nearby with full PPE, creating a visible contrast in compliance.
The safety officer approaches Worker B and points at the missing helmet, speaking to them. Worker B gestures apologetically and begins walking back toward the PPE station.

videos.title: Restricted Machine Zone
videos.summary: A person crosses the yellow safety boundary line into the restricted CNC machine area while a robotic arm is operating. No PPE is worn. Another worker outside the boundary notices and signals frantically before the person exits.

snapshots.caption: A person approaches the yellow safety boundary line painted on the floor around a large CNC machine. Warning signs about automatic machinery are posted on the barrier railing.
The person steps over the safety boundary line and enters the restricted zone. A robotic arm is actively moving and performing operations on the far side of the CNC machine.
The person walks within 2 meters of the operating robotic arm while looking at a component on the machine. No helmet, safety jacket, or any other protective gear is visible.
A worker outside the safety boundary notices the person inside the zone and waves frantically while shouting. The person inside looks up but does not move toward the exit immediately.
The person exits the restricted zone by stepping back over the yellow boundary line. The robotic arm continues its operation cycle throughout the entire incident.

videos.title: Loading Bay Truck Operations
videos.summary: Truck MH-12-AB-3456 enters the loading bay for loading and exits. Truck GJ-05-CD-7890 enters for unloading with a 20-second delay at the dock. Congestion occurs near the dock when four workers gather at the tailgate. Forklift blocked by the crowd.

snapshots.caption: Loading bay area with dock doors open and ready. No trucks present. Two dock workers stand near the dock leveler. A forklift is parked nearby with its forks lowered.
Truck with number plate MH-12-AB-3456 reverses into the loading bay guided by hand signals from a dock worker. The forklift operator watches and prepares to approach.
Loading in progress. The forklift moves pallets from the dock staging area into Truck MH-12-AB-3456. Two workers on the dock secure the load with straps.
Truck MH-12-AB-3456 exits the loading bay after loading is complete. The forklift returns to the staging area. A second truck with number plate GJ-05-CD-7890 waits at the bay entrance.
Truck GJ-05-CD-7890 reverses slowly into the bay. Unloading begins immediately. Four workers gather near the tailgate, creating congestion and blocking the pathway.
Unloading pauses for 20 seconds. One worker checks a paper manifest while others wait idly. The forklift is blocked by the crowd of workers and cannot approach the dock.
Unloading complete. Truck GJ-05-CD-7890 exits the loading bay. Dock workers disperse. The forklift moves forward now that the congestion has cleared.

videos.title: Forklift Near Pedestrian Walkway
videos.summary: Forklift travels along a pathway adjacent to a pedestrian walkway. Pedestrians walk within 1 meter of the forklift path. A near-miss occurs when a pedestrian steps directly into the forklift path without looking.

snapshots.caption: A forklift moves slowly along the designated vehicle pathway. A yellow painted pedestrian walkway runs parallel to the left. No pedestrians are visible yet.
Two workers walk along the pedestrian walkway as the forklift approaches from behind. Both workers face forward and do not appear aware of the forklift approaching.
The forklift passes within 1 meter of the pedestrians. One worker's elbow extends slightly beyond the yellow line into the forklift's path. The horn is not sounded.
The forklift continues forward. A pedestrian walking from the opposite direction is not on the pedestrian walkway but instead walks on the edge of the forklift pathway.
Near-miss: The pedestrian steps fully into the forklift path without looking or pausing. The forklift operator honks loudly and brakes suddenly. The pedestrian jumps backward in surprise.

The forklift comes to a complete stop. The pedestrian stands on the pedestrian walkway and gestures apologetically. The operator signals to stay on the walkway. The forklift resumes after a brief pause.

videos.title: Warehouse Gate Night Surveillance
videos.summary: After 10 PM, the warehouse gate opens and a known employee exits. Later, an unknown person without a uniform or badge enters through the open gate and moves toward the storage area. No security personnel are visible during the breach.

snapshots.caption: Night view of the warehouse main gate. A single street lamp illuminates the gate area. The gate is closed and the premises appear quiet. No movement visible.
The gate begins to open automatically. A person in a company uniform walks through from inside and exits to the outside. The gate begins closing behind them.
The gate is fully closed again. The area is empty. In the distance, a faint figure can be seen approaching the gate from the outside, walking along the road.
An unknown person approaches the closed gate. They are not wearing a company uniform or visible badge. They stop at the gate and pull at the latch mechanism.
The gate opens. The unknown person slips through the gap quickly and walks at a brisk pace toward the warehouse storage building. No security personnel are visible at the gate.
The unknown person continues along the side of the warehouse building, staying close to the wall. They appear familiar with the layout. No alarms are audible.
The unknown person disappears behind a stack of pallets near the storage entrance. The gate remains open behind them with no one attending it.

videos.title: Assembly Line Crowding
videos.summary: During shift change, more than 10 workers gather near the assembly line handoff points. Two clusters form near Station 4 and Station 6, each with 5+ people. The assembly line slows due to congestion before normalizing.

snapshots.caption: Normal assembly line operation. Six workers are at their respective stations performing standard tasks. The line moves at regular speed with components flowing smoothly.
Shift change begins. Workers from the outgoing shift gather near the Station 4 handoff point. Approximately 8 workers are clustered in the area, blocking the aisle.
Crowding intensifies. Approximately 12 workers are now gathered in two clusters near Station 4 and Station 6. The assembly line speed visibly decreases due to congestion around the workstations.
The shift handoff process completes. Workers begin dispersing from the clusters. The crowd reduces to 4-5 people. The assembly line speed begins to increase.
Normal operation resumes. Only current shift workers remain at their stations. No crowding is visible in the aisles or near the workstations.

videos.title: Conveyor Area Monitoring
videos.summary: Conveyor belt stops for 20 seconds due to a jam. The operator is away from the panel and does not attend immediately. The operator returns and clears the jam. Later, a box falls off the conveyor at a curve and is not immediately noticed.

snapshots.caption: Conveyor belt moving normally with evenly spaced boxes. An operator stands near the control panel monitoring the flow. The merge point where two belts combine is functioning smoothly.
The conveyor belt stops abruptly. A box is wedged at the merge point causing a jam. The operator is not at the control panel but is walking away toward a different area.
The conveyor remains stopped. No operator is in frame. Boxes pile up behind the jam point. A warning light on the control panel flashes amber.
The operator returns to the control panel, notices the jam, and walks to the merge point. They remove the misaligned box. The conveyor restarts and accumulated boxes begin flowing again.
Conveyor operation returns to normal. Then a box falls off the side of the belt at a curved section. The box lands on the floor. No worker notices the fallen box.
The operator notices the fallen box on the floor, walks to the curve, and picks it up. They inspect it for damage and place it back on the conveyor. Operation normalizes.

videos.title: Electrical Room Access
videos.summary: A person without an authorized badge approaches the electrical room, opens the door without using the keycard reader, and enters for 25 seconds. The door is marked RESTRICTED ACCESS. They exit and walk away quickly.

snapshots.caption: The electrical room door in a quiet corridor. A red sign on the door reads RESTRICTED ACCESS AUTHORIZED PERSONNEL ONLY. A keycard reader is mounted on the wall next to the door.
A person approaches the electrical room door. They walk past the keycard reader without pausing and instead reach directly for the door handle.
The person opens the door and enters the electrical room. A brief glimpse of electrical panels and wiring inside is visible before the door closes behind them.
The door remains closed. The person is inside the electrical room. No other personnel pass through the corridor during this time.
The door opens and the person exits the electrical room. They look left and right down the corridor, then walk away quickly. No visible badge or identification.

videos.title: Slip Trip and Near-Miss Incidents
videos.summary: An oily spill on the factory floor causes a worker carrying a box to slip and stumble. A separate incident involves a worker tripping over an unsecured cable crossing a walkway. A supervisor places a warning sign after the first incident.

snapshots.caption: Factory floor near a machining station. A dark oily patch is visible on the floor. Workers walk around it cautiously, giving it a wide berth.
A worker carrying a cardboard box approaches the oily patch. The box blocks their downward view preventing them from seeing the hazard on the floor.

The worker steps onto the oily patch. Their foot slides forward and they lose balance. They stumble and catch themselves on a nearby workbench. The box falls and its contents spill. The worker is not injured.
A different area of the factory. Multiple cables run across the pedestrian walkway. The cables are not covered with protective ramps or taped down to the floor.
A worker walks at a normal pace and catches their foot on the loose cables. They trip forward, taking two stumbling steps before regaining their balance. They pause and look back at the cables.
A supervisor arrives at the spill area with a yellow wet-floor warning sign and places it near the patch. Another worker arrives with cleaning equipment to address the spill.

videos.title: Main Gate Vehicle Log
videos.summary: Three vehicles pass through the main gate: sedan MH-01-EF-1234 enters, truck HR-26-GH-5678 enters, truck DL-1L-IJ-9012 exits. Congestion builds at the dispatch area with multiple trucks queued. Another truck arrives at the entrance adding to the queue.

snapshots.caption: The main gate of the factory. A security guard is in the booth. The gate is closed with the boom barrier down. No vehicles are waiting.
A white sedan with number plate MH-01-EF-1234 approaches the gate and stops. The driver shows an ID badge to the security guard. The boom barrier rises and the sedan enters.
A truck with number plate HR-26-GH-5678 arrives at the entrance. The driver hands paperwork to the security guard who inspects it. The boom barrier rises and the truck enters the premises.
View inside the premises at the dispatch area. Three trucks are queued near the dispatch office, waiting in a line. The area is congested with limited space for maneuvering.
A truck with number plate DL-1L-IJ-9012 approaches the main gate from inside the factory. The driver stops and hands a document to the security guard through the window.
The boom barrier rises and truck DL-1L-IJ-9012 exits the premises. Meanwhile, another truck arrives at the entrance from outside, adding to the queue.
The boom barrier lowers. The newly arrived truck at the entrance continues waiting. The dispatch area remains congested with queued vehicles.

videos.title: Night Shift Plant Activity
videos.summary: During night shift, Storage Zone C remains unattended for the entire duration. Two workers are in the break room instead of on the production floor. A side door near the storage zone is found slightly ajar. Low staffing levels across the plant.

snapshots.caption: Night shift on the dimly lit plant floor. Only two workers are visible at distant stations. Storage Zone C in the foreground is completely empty with no personnel present.
Storage Zone C remains unattended. No workers are in this section of the plant. A side door leading to the exterior is slightly ajar near the zone.
Wide shot of the plant floor. The majority of workstations are unoccupied. Only three workers are visible across the entire frame. Storage Zone C is still empty.
View inside the break room. Two workers are sitting at a table with coffee cups. Through the window behind them, the production floor appears largely empty.
Storage Zone C remains unattended. The side door is now more open than before. A draft from outside moves papers on a nearby desk.
The two workers leave the break room and walk back toward their stations on the production floor. The plant begins to show slightly more activity.
Workers are now at their stations but Storage Zone C remains empty. The side door appears to be closed again. The plant is in a low-activity night state.

videos.title: Admin Block Unknown Movement
videos.summary: Between 11 AM and 12 PM, an unknown person with no ID badge walks through the admin block corridor. They stop at the HR office door and peer through the glass. They proceed to the restricted finance section door, find it locked, and retreat.

snapshots.caption: Admin block corridor during daytime. A wall clock shows approximately 11:05 AM. Two employees walk past carrying coffee cups and files.
A person with no visible ID badge walks through the corridor. They are not wearing the standard company uniform. They walk slowly, looking at nameplates on office doors.
The unknown person stops at the HR office door and peers through the glass panel for about 5 seconds. They do not knock or enter. They then continue walking down the corridor.
The person turns the corner toward the finance section. A sign on the wall reads RESTRICTED FINANCE AND ACCOUNTS with a red keycard reader next to the door.
The person tries the finance section door handle. The door is locked. They glance around, then turn around and walk back the way they came, exiting the corridor.

videos.title: Unloading Bay Congestion
videos.summary: Two trucks unload simultaneously at adjacent docks causing congestion. A pedestrian walks behind a reversing truck without a spotter. Stacking overflow in the aisle blocks the forklift from passing. Workers reorganize to clear the path.

snapshots.caption: Unloading bay with two dock positions. Dock 1 has a truck actively unloading with a forklift staging nearby. Dock 2 is empty and ready.
A second truck reverses toward Dock 2. A pedestrian walks directly behind the reversing truck within 2 meters of its rear bumper. No spotter is guiding the driver from behind.
The pedestrian continues walking behind the reversing truck. The truck's reverse lights flash and backup alarm beeps. The pedestrian does not appear to notice or react.
Both docks are now active. Dock 1 forklift unloads pallets onto the staging area. Dock 2 workers manually unload boxes onto the floor. The area between the docks fills with stacked goods.
Stacking overflow: pallets and boxes are piled in the narrow aisle between the two docks, reducing the walkway width by half. Workers navigate single-file around the pile.
The forklift approaches the aisle but cannot pass due to the overflow pile. The driver waits. Workers begin reorganizing and moving the stacked goods to clear the path.

videos.title: Store Opening Procedure
videos.summary: Store shutter opens at 9:02 AM, 2 minutes late. Lights were turned on when the first staff member entered at 8:50 AM, meaning lights were on before official opening. Staff enter and set up before opening. Customers queue outside.

snapshots.caption: Store exterior before opening hours. The roll-down shutter is fully down and locked. No lights are visible through the glass storefront. The time appears to be approximately 8:30 AM.
A staff member arrives and unlocks a side door at approximately 8:50 AM. They enter the store. Moments later, the interior lights turn on, illuminating the sales floor.
Interior view through the glass. Lights are fully on. Two staff members are inside arranging displays and straightening merchandise. A third staff member emerges from the back office.
Exterior view. The roll-down shutter begins to rise at approximately 9:02 AM. A small queue of 3 customers has formed outside, waiting for the store to open.
The shutter is fully open. The first customers enter the store. A staff member at the greeter station welcomes them with a smile. Opening procedure is complete but 2 minutes behind schedule.

videos.title: Cash Counter Queue
videos.summary: A queue of 6 customers builds at the billing counter. Only one of two POS terminals is staffed. A customer waits over 7 minutes and leaves without being served. A second cashier finally arrives to relieve the queue.

snapshots.caption: Billing counter with two POS terminals. Only one terminal is active with a single cashier serving a customer. Three customers are waiting in line.
The queue grows to 5 customers. The second POS terminal remains unstaffed and dark. The active cashier works efficiently but the line is not reducing.
Queue now extends to 6 customers. One customer checks their watch and looks around the store impatiently. No additional staff arrives to open the second terminal.
The second POS terminal is still empty. A customer near the front of the queue sighs loudly and shifts their weight from foot to foot repeatedly.
The queue remains at 5 to 6 customers. A customer at the back of the line places their shopping basket on a nearby shelf and walks out of the store without being served.
A second staff member arrives and opens the second POS terminal. The queue begins to reduce as both terminals serve customers simultaneously.
Both POS terminals are working. The queue is down to 2 customers. The earlier customer who left without being served is no longer in the store.

videos.title: Sales Floor Staff Activity
videos.summary: A staff member spends over 2 minutes on a mobile phone in the sales zone while customers walk past needing assistance. The entrance greeting area has no staff present. A staff member sits idle in the changing room area during apparent peak hours.

snapshots.caption: Sales floor in the apparel section. A moderate number of customers are browsing through racks. No staff member is visible in this section of the store.
A uniformed staff member stands near a display rack, looking down at a mobile phone in their hand. They scroll through the screen, not attending to the surrounding customers.
The same staff member remains on the phone. A customer walks past them, glances at them, and continues walking. The staff member does not look up or offer assistance.
A customer approaches and speaks to the staff member. The staff member puts the phone away and responds. The entrance greeting area is visible in the background and has no staff present.
Changing room area. A staff member sits on a stool near the fitting rooms, appearing disengaged. Multiple customers browse nearby racks but no one proactively offers help.
A different staff member walks through the sales floor and helps a customer locate an item on a high shelf. The mobile phone usage has stopped. The entrance now has a greeter.

videos.title: Stock Room Restricted Access
videos.summary: A person in casual clothes (no store uniform) walks down the back corridor, stops at the stock room door marked STAFF ONLY, looks around suspiciously, and tries the locked door. Finding it locked, they retreat.

snapshots.caption: The stock room door in the back corridor. A prominent sign on the door reads STAFF ONLY RESTRICTED ACCESS. The door is closed and appears secure.
A person wearing casual clothes and no store uniform walks down the corridor. They slow down as they approach the stock room door, looking at the sign.
The person stops at the stock room door and looks left and right down the corridor in a cautious manner. They reach for the door handle.
The person tries the door handle and pulls. The door does not open. They try again with more force. The door remains locked. They step back and read the sign.
The person turns around and walks back the way they came, exiting the corridor. No one else was present in the corridor during the incident.

videos.title: Store Closing and After-Hours
videos.summary: Store closes at 9 PM but the shutter comes down at 9:05 PM, 5 minutes late. A figure is visible inside near the cash counter after hours. Lights are dimmed but a faint light remains in the back.

snapshots.caption: Store interior near closing time at approximately 9:00 PM. A staff announcement plays over the PA system. The last customers are heading toward the billing counter with their purchases.
Exterior view. The roll-down shutter begins to descend at approximately 9:05 PM. The store lights are still fully on inside. The shutter reaches the halfway point.
Interior view after the shutter is down. The main lights have been dimmed but not turned off completely. A figure is visible moving near the cash counter area.
The figure near the cash counter crouches down behind the counter as if accessing a drawer or safe. The movement appears to be a staff member completing end-of-day procedures.
Exterior view. The main store lights are now turned off. However, a faint light is visible from the back of the store. No movement is visible from outside.
The faint back-of-store light turns off. The store is now in complete darkness. No further movement is detected. The store appears fully secured.

videos.title: Customer Arrival No Response
videos.summary: A customer enters the store at 11 AM and no staff greets them. They wander for over 4 minutes without any staff interaction. A second customer enters and also waits unattended. Staff finally approach after 5 minutes.

snapshots.caption: Store entrance. A customer walks in through the main door. The greeter station near the entrance has no staff member present. The customer pauses and looks around.
The customer stands near the entrance area for a few seconds, looking for assistance. No staff member approaches. They begin walking into the store on their own.
The customer is in the home goods aisle examining kitchen products. They look up and down the aisle for a staff member. No one is visible. They pick up an item, examine it, and put it back.
A second customer enters the store through the main entrance. The same scenario repeats: no greeter, no staff response. The second customer pauses at the entrance looking confused.
The first customer has moved to the electronics section. They have been in the store for approximately 4 minutes without any staff member speaking to them or offering assistance.
The second customer walks toward the first customer. They appear to exchange a few words, possibly commenting on the lack of staff presence in the store.
A staff member finally approaches the first customer in the electronics section, gesturing apologetically. Shortly after, another staff member approaches the second customer.

videos.title: Staff Zone Gaps and Break Gaps
videos.summary: Four staff members gather near the back office chatting while customers wait on the sales floor. No staff present in the kids section for over 2 minutes. A parent with a child looks for assistance without success.

snapshots.caption: Back office corridor. Four staff members in uniform are gathered together talking and laughing. One staff member shows something on a mobile phone to the others.
Sales floor in the home section. Multiple customers are browsing. One customer looks around the area trying to locate a staff member. No staff are visible in this section.
The kids section of the store. No staff member is present. A parent with a young child is looking at toys on the shelf. The parent looks around for assistance.
The parent in the kids section picks up a toy, looks around for a staff member or price check, and puts it back down. They continue waiting. Still no staff arrives.
A staff member finally walks through the kids section. The parent immediately approaches them. In the background, the back office corridor is now empty as staff have dispersed to the floor.

videos.title: Lunch Rush High Footfall
videos.summary: Between 12:30 PM and 1:30 PM, the store experiences peak footfall with 50+ customers visible. Only 2 floor staff are on duty. The billing queue reaches 8 people. Staff-to-customer ratio is critically low.

snapshots.caption: Store entrance area around 12:30 PM. Customers enter steadily through the main doors. Five customers walk in within a 10-second window. The footfall is visibly at peak levels.
Wide shot of the sales floor. Every aisle and section has customers browsing. Approximately 15 to 20 customers are visible in a single frame. Only 1 floor staff member is visible.
The billing counter. A queue of 8 people snakes through the roped area. Both POS terminals are active. The cashier at one terminal looks stressed and processes items quickly.
The sales floor from a different angle. 25 or more customers are visible across multiple sections. The total floor staff count remains at 2. Customers look around with items in hand.
Aisle near the grocery and snacks section. The aisle is congested with customers navigating around each other with shopping baskets. No staff member is in this section.
The billing queue begins to reduce and is now at 5 customers. An additional staff member arrives to assist with bagging. Footfall at the entrance starts to decrease.
The store returns to normal footfall levels. Staff count on the floor increases to 4. The billing queue is down to 3 customers. The lunch rush is subsiding.

videos.title: Jewelry Display Security
videos.summary: A person spends over 10 minutes near the jewelry display case, leaning over the glass and glancing around repeatedly without making a purchase request. They watch a staff member serve another customer, then leave without speaking to anyone.

snapshots.caption: The jewelry display section with glass cases featuring necklaces, rings, and watches. A staff member stands behind the counter assisting a customer with a tray of rings.
A person approaches the display case. They do not make eye contact with or speak to the staff member. Instead, they lean over the glass to examine the items closely.
The person moves along the length of the display case, looking at different sections. They glance around the store repeatedly rather than focusing on any specific item.
Another customer is being served at the display case. The first person steps back from the counter but remains in the area, watching the interaction from a short distance.
The first person turns and leaves the jewelry section without speaking to any staff or making a purchase. The staff member glances up briefly as they walk away.

videos.title: Backdoor and Perimeter Activity
videos.summary: A person approaches the store's backdoor in the alleyway. The door is unlocked and they open it to peer inside. A staff member pushes the door closed and locks it from inside. The person then loiters near the back wall before leaving.

snapshots.caption: The backdoor of the store viewed from the alleyway. Trash bins are lined up against the wall. The door is closed and no one is visible in the alley.
A person walks through the alley and approaches the backdoor. They stop at the door and try the handle. The door opens as it was not locked.
The person opens the door partway and peers inside. They do not step through the doorway but appear to be surveying the interior visible from the threshold.
A staff member appears inside the doorway, pushes the door closed from the other side, and the sound of a lock clicking is audible. The person outside steps back.
The person does not leave the alley. Instead, they move to the side of the building and stand near the wall, looking at the backdoor from a distance of about 5 meters.
The person loiters near the back wall for approximately 10 more seconds, then turns and walks away down the alley. No entry to the store was achieved.

videos.title: Zone-wise Customer Engagement
videos.summary: Electronics zone has 8 customers with zero staff. Home goods has 4 customers with one staff member helping. Kids section has 5 customers and one overwhelmed staff member. Staff finally rebalance to cover the electronics zone after a delay.

snapshots.caption: Electronics zone with laptops, phones, and accessories on display. Approximately 8 customers are browsing and picking up devices. No staff member is present in this zone.
The electronics zone remains without staff. A customer presses a call button near a display. The button lights up but no staff member responds. Customers continue browsing unattended.
Home goods zone. About 4 customers are browsing kitchenware and home decor. One staff member is demonstrating a product to a customer while other customers browse nearby without assistance.
The kids section. 5 customers are present including families with children. One staff member is helping a single family while two other customers wait nearby with items in hand.
The staff member from home goods finishes their demonstration and begins walking toward the electronics zone. Electronics customers notice the approaching staff member.
The electronics zone now has one staff member helping customers. All zones have at least minimal staff coverage. Customers in the kids section are being served in turn.
